segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Laura. I wanted to confirm the updated quote for the support analytics package: 42 seats, annual term, starting May 1, comes to $31,920 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what I had. The only thing I want to check is the implementation fee. Last version showed $4,500 and this one shows $3,750.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. We took out the custom dashboard workshop since your team said the standard reports are fine for phase one. So onboarding is still included, just not that extra session.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, good. And for billing, can you split the invoice by department? We need 28 seats under customer operations and 14 under account management.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can do that in the billing tool. It'll still be one contract, but two invoice lines with those department labels. Net 30 terms, same as your current agreement.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Legal had one note on the renewal language. They want the auto-renew notice window to be 60 days instead of 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That should be fine. I'll send it through deal desk, but it's a standard change for us. No change to pricing or the May 1 start date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If you can get the revised order form over today, I can route it for signature tomorrow. Our cutover target is May 6, after payroll closes.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. I'll update the order form, attach the split-invoice note, and send it by 3 PM Eastern. Once signed, our onboarding manager will schedule the admin kickoff for the week of April 22.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send it to me and copy Evan in procurement. We'll turn it around as soon as we have the final version.
